segments.name: Security
segments.description: Provides end-to-end security and video surveillance solutions under the Vicon brand for corporate, industrial, and governmental customers.
segments.evidence: Cemtrex's Security segment operates under the brand of its majority owned subsidiary, Vicon Industries, Inc. ("Vicon"), which provides end-to-end security solutions to meet the toughest corporate, industrial, and governmental security challenges.

segments.name: Industrial Services
segments.description: Offers single-source rigging, millwrighting, maintenance, and equipment installation services under the AIS brand to diversified industrial customers.
segments.evidence: Cemtrex's Industrial Services segment operates under the brand, Advanced Industrial Services ("AIS"), which offers single-source expertise and services for rigging, millwrighting, in plant maintenance, equipment erection, relocation, and disassembly to diversified customers.
